correctness.summary: The corrected Hermite-Laguerre identity converts f_n into a positive Hermite-square weight integrated against K_q(u)=sum_{j>=0} q^j cos(sqrt(j)u), q=e^{-x/2}. Unique decomposition j=d m^2 with d squarefree groups K_q into theta_3 blocks. Jacobi's product gives each block a theta_4 lower bound; recombining the block minima yields K_q(u)>=(1-q-q^2-q^3)/(1-q^4). Thus K_q is nonnegative when q<=rho, where rho+rho^2+rho^3=1. At q=rho, K_q(0)>0 and continuity makes the integral strictly positive. Algebraic normalization and the corrected Hermite-Laguerre scaling were recomputed algebraically.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The 2025 correction explicitly restores the known uniform theorem x>2 log 2 and states only that this interval could be slightly refined by alternative Laguerre integral representations. Searches of the exact derivative problem, the cubic threshold, squarefree/theta formulations, Hermite-Laguerre theta combinations, and recent citation/title variants did not locate the bound x>=-2 log rho or the squarefree-theta kernel argument. The 2005 Alzer-Berg-Koumandos paper and the 2024/2025 Castillo papers identify the uniform-threshold question, but the available statements do not supply this bound. A differently phrased, unpublished, or poorly indexed stronger result remains possible.

value.summary: The theorem gives an explicit, rigorous reduction of the current corrected uniform threshold from 2 log 2 = 1.38629... to 1.218755..., using a reusable arithmetic decomposition of a nonharmonic cosine kernel into Jacobi-theta blocks. It also includes the new threshold endpoint.

limitations: The sufficient threshold -2 log rho is not proved optimal.
The smallest derivative order that can fail below the threshold is not determined.
The 2025 correction mentions unspecified slight refinements of 2 log 2, so those unpublished details could overlap numerically or methodologically.
The full text of Al-Musallam-Bustoz (2006) was not separately inspected; its stated theorem was checked through later primary literature.
A differently phrased, unpublished, or poorly indexed stronger bound may exist.
Independent audit has not been performed.
